observations.text: Flat grid, no folders, no search, no sort control, no tags. Cards show a 4-image cover mosaic, name (all 'Untitled' — auto-naming not applied), and 更新于 date.
Select mode adds a checkbox to every card (bulk action bar not observed with zero selection; delete would be irreversible so not tested).
Hovering a card revealed no contextual menu (no rename/duplicate/delete affordance on hover).
Project = the canvas document; one project maps to one /canvas?projectId. Six projects exist on this account, five created 2026-07-12 (bulk, likely by earlier sessions).
Rename/delete location (maybe inside the canvas project-name menu); pagination beyond one screen.
